headline: Stock Market Week of 05-09/10/2026: Still Unable to Recover
summary: The VN-Index failed to recover last week as cash flows stayed fragmented and foreign investors continued net selling. Traders are watching the 1,715-1,750 point support zone.
why: The VN-Index is the benchmark index of the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange, Vietnam's main equity market. Sustained foreign net selling can weigh on liquidity and valuations in emerging-market equities.
